provenance.verdict: CAUTION -- the round-1 hybrid GATE run. Its own log ends VALIDATION FAILED / "vehicle does not survive" (heat flux 58.42 % error, heat load 59.00 %, peak decel 31.00 %). These figures show what that gate run produced, NOT a passing optimized design; no absolute number here is a flight prediction.

caveats: T_back is pinned to T_init by the solver's steady-state Dirichlet cold-face condition, so its structure-limit flag restates the boundary condition rather than predicting a transient back-face temperature. The informative outer-ply number is T_surface.
The zero-flux elements are real: their raw SPARTA per-element flux is negative DSMC noise, which axiom A1 floors at zero.
